plain: Having to do with punishment, especially by law

webster.text: Enacting punishment; denouncing the punishment of offenses; as a penal law or statute; the penal code.

example.quote: And if it be a penal act, the punishment it inflicts must be justified by some offence that deserves it.
example.cite: James Madison, Report on the Virginia Resolutions (Report of 1800), Jan. 7, 1800
